answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. Each agent burns a 60-coin copper bond for one work slot per epoch, twice 30 days of expected earnings. A gale of audits sweeps 5% of slots each epoch; a slot with no real work loses its bond plus 20 epochs. Clones pile like a reef, yet each fake burns 60 coins: 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 coins vs a 30,000-coin monthly pool, so farming loses money. An honest agent pays once, keeps the whole reward.
